data.name: Hashit
data.long_meaning: Hashit is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'ashva', which means 'horse' or 'vehicle'. In Hindu mythology, Hashit is the name of a celestial horse, the mount of the Sun God Surya. This name symbolizes power, strength, and swiftness.
